ko.title: $4,000 개학: 관세가 개학 쇼핑을 부채 결정으로 바꾼 방법

segments.src: ## A Shopping List That Costs More Than It Used To
segments.tr: ## 이전보다 비싼 쇼핑 리스트

segments.src: For millions of families, the ritual of back-to-school shopping has quietly turned into one of the biggest financial stress tests of the year.
segments.tr: 수백만 가족에게 개학 시즌 쇼핑은 조용히 한 해의 가장 큰 재정 스트레스 시험 중 하나가 되었습니다.

segments.src: Industry surveys tracking household spending now put the average cost of outfitting a single child for the new school year at close to $4,000 once tuition-adjacent costs, clothing, electronics, and everyday supplies are added together.
segments.tr: 가정 지출을 추적하는 업계 조사에 따르면 수업료 관련 비용, 의류, 전자 제품, 일상용품을 모두 합치면 새 학년을 위해 한 자녀를 준비시키는 평균 비용이 거의 $4,000에 이릅니다.

segments.src: That figure has been climbing for several years, but this season feels different to a lot of parents — and the reason many point to is tariffs.
segments.tr: 이 수치는 몇 년 동안 계속 상승해왔지만, 이번 시즌은 많은 부모들에게 다르게 느껴집니다. 많은 부모들이 지적하는 이유는 관세입니다.

segments.src: A wide share of the products that fill a typical school shopping cart — notebooks, backpacks, lunch boxes, sneakers, and basic apparel — are manufactured overseas and imported into the United States.
segments.tr: 개학 쇼핑 카트를 채우는 많은 제품들(노트북, 배낭, 도시락 상자, 운동화, 기본 의류)은 해외에서 제조되어 미국으로 수입됩니다.

segments.src: When import tariffs rise on those categories, the added cost doesn't stay with the manufacturer or the importer for long.
segments.tr: 이러한 카테고리에 대한 수입 관세가 오르면 추가 비용은 제조업체나 수입업체에 오래 머물지 않습니다.

segments.src: It tends to move down the supply chain until it lands on a store shelf, and ultimately, in a parent's shopping cart.
segments.tr: 비용은 공급 사슬을 따라 내려가다가 결국 매장 진열대에 도달하고, 궁극적으로 부모의 쇼핑 카트에 들어갑니다.

segments.src: ## Where the Price Increases Are Showing Up
segments.tr: ## 가격 인상이 나타나는 곳

segments.src: Retail analysts tracking this back-to-school season say the sharpest increases are concentrated in a handful of categories that were already price-sensitive for families:
segments.tr: 이번 개학 시즌을 추적하는 소매 분석가들은 가장 큰 가격 인상이 이미 가정에서 가격에 민감한 몇 가지 카테고리에 집중되어 있다고 말합니다:

segments.src: - **School supplies** such as notebooks, binders, and basic stationery, many of which are produced in facilities affected by new tariff schedules.
segments.tr: - **학용품**(노트, 바인더, 기본 문구류 등)으로, 많은 제품이 새로운 관세 정책의 영향을 받는 시설에서 생산됩니다.

segments.src: - **Lunch boxes and insulated bags**, a category dominated by imported goods with limited domestic manufacturing alternatives.
segments.tr: - **도시락 상자와 보온백**으로, 수입 제품으로 지배되며 국내 제조 대안이 제한적인 카테고리입니다.

segments.src: - **Clothing and footwear**, where apparel tariffs have compounded with existing cost pressures from labor and shipping.
segments.tr: - **의류와 신발**로, 의류 관세가 노동력과 배송으로 인한 기존 비용 압력과 겹쳐 작용했습니다.

segments.src: - **Basic electronics accessories**, including calculators, headphones, and chargers commonly required for middle and high school classes.
segments.tr: - **기본 전자 제품 액세서리**(계산기, 헤드폰, 충전기 등)로 중학교와 고등학교 수업에서 일반적으로 필요합니다.

segments.src: Several of these categories are reportedly seeing price increases in the double digits compared to last year, according to retail pricing trackers — a jump that is hard for many household budgets to absorb without some kind of trade-off.
segments.tr: 소매 가격 추적 데이터에 따르면 이 중 여러 카테고리가 작년 대비 두 자리 수 가격 인상을 보이고 있으며, 이는 많은 가정 예산이 어떤 종류의 절충 없이 감당하기 어려운 수준입니다.

segments.src: ## Nearly Half of Parents Say They'll Borrow to Cover It
segments.tr: ## 거의 절반의 부모들이 빌려서 충당할 것이라고 말합니다

segments.src: What makes this year notable isn't just the price tag — it's how families say they plan to pay for it.
segments.tr: 올해가 주목할 만한 이유는 단순히 가격이 아니라 가정에서 어떻게 지불할 계획인지입니다.

segments.src: Recent consumer surveys suggest that nearly half of parents expect to rely on some form of credit, whether that's a credit card balance carried past the due date, a "buy now, pay later" installment plan, or a short-term loan, just to get through the shopping list.
segments.tr: 최근 소비자 조사에 따르면 거의 절반의 부모들이 신용카드 연체 잔금, "지금 구매, 나중에 결제" 할부 계획, 또는 단기 대출 등 어떤 형태의 신용에 의존할 것으로 예상하며, 이는 단순히 쇼핑 리스트를 완료하기 위한 것입니다.

segments.src: For financial counselors, that's a meaningful shift.
segments.tr: 재무 상담가들에게 이것은 의미 있는 변화입니다.

segments.src: Back-to-school spending has traditionally been treated as a predictable, budgeted expense — closer to a utility bill than a financial emergency.
segments.tr: 개학 지출은 전통적으로 예측 가능한 예산 항목으로 취급되어 왔습니다. 금융 긴급상황보다는 공과금에 더 가깝습니다.

segments.src: When a routine seasonal purchase starts requiring borrowed money for a large share of households, it's often read as a signal of broader strain on discretionary budgets, not just a one-off spike in school supply prices.
segments.tr: 일상적인 계절 구매가 많은 가정에서 빌린 돈을 필요로 하기 시작할 때, 그것은 종종 학용품 가격의 일회성 급등이 아니라 광범위한 재량 예산 압박의 신호로 해석됩니다.

segments.src: ## Why This Year Is Being Called a Turning Point
segments.tr: ## 올해가 전환점이라고 불리는 이유

segments.src: Economists who track consumer goods pricing note that this may be the first back-to-school season where the majority of a typical shopping list is made up of products directly affected by new tariff policy.
segments.tr: 소비자 상품 가격을 추적하는 경제학자들은 이것이 전형적인 쇼핑 리스트의 대부분이 새로운 관세 정책의 직접적인 영향을 받는 제품으로 구성된 첫 개학 시즌일 수 있다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: In previous years, tariff impacts were more concentrated in specific categories, like electronics or certain apparel segments.
segments.tr: 지난 몇 년에는 관세의 영향이 전자 제품이나 특정 의류 부문과 같은 특정 카테고리에 더 집중되어 있었습니다.

segments.src: This year, the breadth of affected goods — from paper products to footwear — means fewer families have an easy substitution available.
segments.tr: 올해는 영향을 받는 제품의 범위(종이 제품에서 신발에 이르기까지)가 넓어서 쉬운 대체 상품을 구할 수 있는 가정이 적습니다.

segments.src: That breadth is part of why the story has resonated beyond typical economic reporting.
segments.tr: 그 광범위함은 이 이야기가 전형적인 경제 보도를 초월하여 공감을 불러일으킨 이유 중 일부입니다.

segments.src: It isn't an abstract trade statistic; it shows up directly in a parent's total at the register.
segments.tr: 그것은 추상적인 무역 통계가 아닙니다. 부모의 계산대 청구액에 직접 반영됩니다.

segments.src: ## What Families Are Doing Differently
segments.tr: ## 가정에서 다르게 하고 있는 일

segments.src: Facing higher prices across nearly every category, many households are adjusting their shopping habits rather than simply absorbing the cost:
segments.tr: 거의 모든 카테고리에서 높은 가격에 직면한 많은 가정은 단순히 비용을 감당하기보다는 쇼핑 습관을 조정하고 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Buying fewer items per category** and prioritizing what's absolutely required by the school's supply list.
segments.tr: - **카테고리당 적은 항목 구매**하고 학교의 필수 물품 목록에서 필수 항목을 우선하기.

segments.src: - **Shopping secondhand or swapping** clothing and supplies with other families.
segments.tr: - **중고 제품 쇼핑 또는 다른 가정과의 의류·물품 교환**하기.

segments.src: - **Spreading purchases out** across several weeks instead of one large shopping trip, to manage cash flow.
segments.tr: - **구매를 여러 주에 걸쳐 분산**하여 한 번의 대량 쇼핑 대신 현금 흐름을 관리하기.

segments.src: - **Comparing store brands versus name brands** more aggressively than in past years.
segments.tr: - **자체 브랜드와 네임 브랜드를 비교**하기를 지난 몇 년보다 훨씬 적극적으로 하기.

segments.src: - **Using layaway or installment options** at retailers that offer them, rather than defaulting straight to a credit card.
segments.tr: - **선결제 또는 할부 옵션 이용**하기, 이를 제공하는 소매점에서, 신용카드로 바로 결제하는 대신.

segments.src: Financial advisors generally caution that while short-term financing tools can help smooth a one-time expense, relying on revolving credit for a recurring annual cost like school shopping can create a cycle that's difficult to break, especially if next year's prices continue trending upward.
segments.tr: 재무 어드바이저들은 일반적으로 단기 금융 도구가 일회성 비용을 완화할 수 있지만, 개학 쇼핑과 같은 반복되는 연간 비용에 회전 신용에 의존하면 악순환을 만들 수 있다고 경고하며, 특히 내년 가격이 계속 상승 추세를 보인다면 더욱 그렇습니다.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 더 큰 그림

segments.src: Back-to-school spending is often treated as a bellwether for household financial health heading into the fall and holiday shopping season.
segments.tr: 개학 지출은 종종 가을과 휴일 쇼핑 시즌을 앞두고 가정 재정 건강의 지표로 취급됩니다.

segments.src: If a growing share of families are financing routine purchases this early in the year, that trend is likely to draw closer attention from retailers, lenders, and policymakers alike in the months ahead.
segments.tr: 연초부터 증가하는 비율의 가정이 일상적인 구매에 자금을 조달하고 있다면, 그 추세는 앞으로 몇 개월 동안 소매업체, 대출 기관, 정책 입안자들의 관심을 받을 것입니다.

segments.src: For now, though, the immediate reality for many parents is simpler and more pressing: get the list checked off, and figure out how to pay for it later.
segments.tr: 하지만 지금은 많은 부모들의 즉각적인 현실이 더 간단하고 긴급합니다: 리스트를 완료하고, 나중에 이를 어떻게 지불할지 생각하는 것입니다.

zh.title: $4,000学年：关税如何将返校购物变成了债务决策

segments.src: ## A Shopping List That Costs More Than It Used To
segments.tr: ## 一份比以前更贵的购物清单

segments.src: For millions of families, the ritual of back-to-school shopping has quietly turned into one of the biggest financial stress tests of the year.
segments.tr: 对于数百万个家庭来说，返校购物的传统已经悄然成为全年最大的财务压力测试之一。

segments.src: Industry surveys tracking household spending now put the average cost of outfitting a single child for the new school year at close to $4,000 once tuition-adjacent costs, clothing, electronics, and everyday supplies are added together.
segments.tr: 追踪家庭支出的行业调查现在表明，一旦加上学费相关成本、衣服、电子产品和日常用品，为一个孩子配备新学年用品的平均成本接近$4,000。

segments.src: That figure has been climbing for several years, but this season feels different to a lot of parents — and the reason many point to is tariffs.
segments.tr: 这个数字多年来一直在上升，但许多家长觉得这个季节不同——许多人指出的原因是关税。

segments.src: A wide share of the products that fill a typical school shopping cart — notebooks, backpacks, lunch boxes, sneakers, and basic apparel — are manufactured overseas and imported into the United States.
segments.tr: 填满典型返校购物车的许多产品——笔记本、背包、午餐盒、运动鞋和基本服装——都是在海外制造并进口到美国的。

segments.src: When import tariffs rise on those categories, the added cost doesn't stay with the manufacturer or the importer for long.
segments.tr: 当这些类别的进口关税上升时，增加的成本不会长时间停留在制造商或进口商那里。

segments.src: It tends to move down the supply chain until it lands on a store shelf, and ultimately, in a parent's shopping cart.
segments.tr: 它往往会沿着供应链向下移动，直到落在商店货架上，最终落在家长的购物车里。

segments.src: ## Where the Price Increases Are Showing Up
segments.tr: ## 价格上涨出现在哪里

segments.src: Retail analysts tracking this back-to-school season say the sharpest increases are concentrated in a handful of categories that were already price-sensitive for families:
segments.tr: 追踪这个返校季的零售分析师表示，最大的价格上涨集中在少数几个对家庭来说已经对价格敏感的类别：

segments.src: - **School supplies** such as notebooks, binders, and basic stationery, many of which are produced in facilities affected by new tariff schedules.
segments.tr: - **学用品**，如笔记本、活页夹和基本文具，其中许多是在受新关税计划影响的设施中生产的。

segments.src: - **Lunch boxes and insulated bags**, a category dominated by imported goods with limited domestic manufacturing alternatives.
segments.tr: - **午餐盒和保温袋**，这个类别由进口商品主导，国内制造替代品有限。

segments.src: - **Clothing and footwear**, where apparel tariffs have compounded with existing cost pressures from labor and shipping.
segments.tr: - **服装和鞋类**，其中服装关税与来自劳动力和运输的现有成本压力相叠加。

segments.src: - **Basic electronics accessories**, including calculators, headphones, and chargers commonly required for middle and high school classes.
segments.tr: - **基本电子配件**，包括计算器、耳机和中学和高中课程中常见的充电器。

segments.src: Several of these categories are reportedly seeing price increases in the double digits compared to last year, according to retail pricing trackers — a jump that is hard for many household budgets to absorb without some kind of trade-off.
segments.tr: 据零售价格追踪机构报道，其中几个类别与去年相比价格上涨两位数——这样的涨幅对许多家庭预算来说很难吸收而不做出某种权衡。

segments.src: ## Nearly Half of Parents Say They'll Borrow to Cover It
segments.tr: ## 近一半的家长表示他们会借钱来支付

segments.src: What makes this year notable isn't just the price tag — it's how families say they plan to pay for it.
segments.tr: 今年的不同之处不仅仅是价格标签——还在于家庭如何表示他们计划支付。

segments.src: Recent consumer surveys suggest that nearly half of parents expect to rely on some form of credit, whether that's a credit card balance carried past the due date, a "buy now, pay later" installment plan, or a short-term loan, just to get through the shopping list.
segments.tr: 最近的消费者调查表明，近一半的家长预计会依赖某种形式的信用，无论是信用卡余额超期、"先买后付"分期付款计划，还是短期贷款，只是为了完成购物清单。

segments.src: For financial counselors, that's a meaningful shift.
segments.tr: 对于财务顾问来说，这是一个有意义的转变。

segments.src: Back-to-school spending has traditionally been treated as a predictable, budgeted expense — closer to a utility bill than a financial emergency.
segments.tr: 返校支出传统上被视为可预测的、有预算的支出——更接近于公用事业账单而不是财务紧急情况。

segments.src: When a routine seasonal purchase starts requiring borrowed money for a large share of households, it's often read as a signal of broader strain on discretionary budgets, not just a one-off spike in school supply prices.
segments.tr: 当例行季节性购买开始需要大量家庭借用资金时，这通常被视为自由支配预算承受更广泛压力的信号，而不仅仅是学用品价格的一次性飙升。

segments.src: ## Why This Year Is Being Called a Turning Point
segments.tr: ## 为什么今年被称为转折点

segments.src: Economists who track consumer goods pricing note that this may be the first back-to-school season where the majority of a typical shopping list is made up of products directly affected by new tariff policy.
segments.tr: 追踪消费品价格的经济学家指出，这可能是第一个返校季，其中典型购物清单的大多数由直接受新关税政策影响的产品组成。

segments.src: In previous years, tariff impacts were more concentrated in specific categories, like electronics or certain apparel segments.
segments.tr: 在前几年，关税影响更集中在特定类别，如电子产品或某些服装类别。

segments.src: This year, the breadth of affected goods — from paper products to footwear — means fewer families have an easy substitution available.
segments.tr: 今年，受影响商品的范围——从纸制品到鞋类——意味着越来越少的家庭有容易的替代品可用。

segments.src: That breadth is part of why the story has resonated beyond typical economic reporting.
segments.tr: 这种广泛性是为什么这个故事在典型经济报道之外引起共鸣的原因之一。

segments.src: It isn't an abstract trade statistic; it shows up directly in a parent's total at the register.
segments.tr: 这不是一个抽象的贸易统计数据；它直接出现在家长的收银机总额中。

segments.src: ## What Families Are Doing Differently
segments.tr: ## 家庭在做什么不同

segments.src: Facing higher prices across nearly every category, many households are adjusting their shopping habits rather than simply absorbing the cost:
segments.tr: 面对几乎所有类别的价格上涨，许多家庭正在调整他们的购物习惯，而不是简单地吸收成本：

segments.src: - **Buying fewer items per category** and prioritizing what's absolutely required by the school's supply list.
segments.tr: - **每个类别购买更少的物品**，并优先考虑学校供应清单绝对需要的内容。

segments.src: - **Shopping secondhand or swapping** clothing and supplies with other families.
segments.tr: - **购买二手或交换**衣服和用品与其他家庭。

segments.src: - **Spreading purchases out** across several weeks instead of one large shopping trip, to manage cash flow.
segments.tr: - **分散购物**到几周，而不是一次大型购物旅行，以管理现金流。

segments.src: - **Comparing store brands versus name brands** more aggressively than in past years.
segments.tr: - **比较店铺品牌与名牌**比过去几年更积极。

segments.src: - **Using layaway or installment options** at retailers that offer them, rather than defaulting straight to a credit card.
segments.tr: - **使用分期付款或分期付款选项**在提供这些选项的零售商那里，而不是直接默认使用信用卡。

segments.src: Financial advisors generally caution that while short-term financing tools can help smooth a one-time expense, relying on revolving credit for a recurring annual cost like school shopping can create a cycle that's difficult to break, especially if next year's prices continue trending upward.
segments.tr: 财务顾问通常会警告，虽然短期融资工具可以帮助平稳一次性支出，但依赖循环信用用于像学校购物这样的经常性年度成本可能会创造一个难以打破的循环，特别是如果明年的价格继续上升。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 更大的图景

hi.title: 4,000 डॉलर की स्कूल साल: कैसे टैरिफ ने स्कूल के लिए खरीदारी को कर्ज के फैसले में बदल दिया

segments.src: ## A Shopping List That Costs More Than It Used To
segments.tr: ## एक शॉपिंग सूची जो पहले से ज्यादा महंगी है

segments.src: For millions of families, the ritual of back-to-school shopping has quietly turned into one of the biggest financial stress tests of the year.
segments.tr: लाखों परिवारों के लिए, स्कूल के लिए खरीदारी की परंपरा चुपचाप साल के सबसे बड़े वित्तीय तनाव परीक्षणों में से एक में बदल गई है।

segments.src: Industry surveys tracking household spending now put the average cost of outfitting a single child for the new school year at close to $4,000 once tuition-adjacent costs, clothing, electronics, and everyday supplies are added together.
segments.tr: उद्योग सर्वेक्षण घरेलू खर्च को ट्रैक करते हुए अब एक बच्चे को नए स्कूल वर्ष के लिए तैयार करने की औसत लागत को $4,000 के करीब रखते हैं, जब ट्यूशन-संबंधित लागतें, कपड़े, इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स और दैनिक आपूर्ति को एक साथ जोड़ा जाता है।

segments.src: That figure has been climbing for several years, but this season feels different to a lot of parents — and the reason many point to is tariffs.
segments.tr: यह आंकड़ा कई वर्षों से बढ़ रहा है, लेकिन इस बार बहुत से माता-पिता को यह साल अलग महसूस हो रहा है — और कई लोग जिस कारण की ओर इशारा करते हैं वह टैरिफ है।

segments.src: A wide share of the products that fill a typical school shopping cart — notebooks, backpacks, lunch boxes, sneakers, and basic apparel — are manufactured overseas and imported into the United States.
segments.tr: स्कूल की शॉपिंग कार्ट में डाली जाने वाली उत्पादों का एक बड़ा हिस्सा — नोटबुक, बैकपैक, लंच बॉक्स, स्नीकर्स, और बुनियादी कपड़े — विदेश में निर्मित और संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका में आयात किए जाते हैं।

segments.src: When import tariffs rise on those categories, the added cost doesn't stay with the manufacturer or the importer for long.
segments.tr: जब उन श्रेणियों पर आयात टैरिफ बढ़ता है, तो अतिरिक्त लागत निर्माता या आयातक के पास लंबे समय के लिए नहीं रहती।

segments.src: It tends to move down the supply chain until it lands on a store shelf, and ultimately, in a parent's shopping cart.
segments.tr: यह आपूर्ति श्रृंखला के नीचे चली जाती है जब तक यह स्टोर की शेल्फ पर न पहुंच जाए, और अंत में, माता-पिता की शॉपिंग कार्ट में।

segments.src: ## Where the Price Increases Are Showing Up
segments.tr: ## जहां कीमतें बढ़ रही हैं

segments.src: Retail analysts tracking this back-to-school season say the sharpest increases are concentrated in a handful of categories that were already price-sensitive for families:
segments.tr: खुदरा विश्लेषक इस बैक-टू-स्कूल सीजन को ट्रैक करते हुए कहते हैं कि सबसे तेज वृद्धि कुछ श्रेणियों में केंद्रित है जो पहले से ही परिवारों के लिए कीमत के प्रति संवेदनशील थीं:

segments.src: - **School supplies** such as notebooks, binders, and basic stationery, many of which are produced in facilities affected by new tariff schedules.
segments.tr: - **स्कूल की आपूर्ति** जैसे नोटबुक, बाइंडर, और मूल स्टेशनरी, जिनमें से कई नई टैरिफ अनुसूचियों से प्रभावित सुविधाओं में बनाई जाती हैं।

segments.src: - **Lunch boxes and insulated bags**, a category dominated by imported goods with limited domestic manufacturing alternatives.
segments.tr: - **लंच बॉक्स और इंसुलेटेड बैग**, एक श्रेणी जो आयातित सामानों द्वारा प्रभुत्व रखती है और घरेलू निर्माण के विकल्प सीमित हैं।

segments.src: - **Clothing and footwear**, where apparel tariffs have compounded with existing cost pressures from labor and shipping.
segments.tr: - **कपड़े और जूते**, जहां वस्त्र टैरिफ मौजूदा श्रम और शिपिंग लागत के दबाव में जुड़ गए हैं।

segments.src: - **Basic electronics accessories**, including calculators, headphones, and chargers commonly required for middle and high school classes.
segments.tr: - **बुनियादी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक सहायक उपकरण**, कैलकुलेटर, हेडफोन, और चार्जर सहित जो आमतौर पर माध्यमिक और उच्च विद्यालय की कक्षाओं के लिए आवश्यक होते हैं।

segments.src: Several of these categories are reportedly seeing price increases in the double digits compared to last year, according to retail pricing trackers — a jump that is hard for many household budgets to absorb without some kind of trade-off.
segments.tr: खुदरा मूल्य निर्धारण ट्रैकर्स के अनुसार, इनमें से कुछ श्रेणियों में पिछले साल की तुलना में दहाई अंकों में कीमतें बढ़ रही हैं — यह वृद्धि कई घरेलू बजट के लिए किसी प्रकार के व्यापार-बंद के बिना सहन करना मुश्किल है।

segments.src: ## Nearly Half of Parents Say They'll Borrow to Cover It
segments.tr: ## लगभग आधे माता-पिता कहते हैं कि वे इसे कवर करने के लिए उधार लेंगे

segments.src: What makes this year notable isn't just the price tag — it's how families say they plan to pay for it.
segments.tr: इस साल को क्या उल्लेखनीय बनाता है सिर्फ कीमत नहीं है — यह है कि परिवार इसके लिए भुगतान करने की योजना कैसे बनाते हैं।

segments.src: Recent consumer surveys suggest that nearly half of parents expect to rely on some form of credit, whether that's a credit card balance carried past the due date, a "buy now, pay later" installment plan, or a short-term loan, just to get through the shopping list.
segments.tr: हाल के उपभोक्ता सर्वेक्षण बताते हैं कि लगभग आधे माता-पिता किसी न किसी प्रकार के क्रेडिट पर निर्भर रहने की उम्मीद करते हैं, चाहे वह क्रेडिट कार्ड की बकाया हो जो देय तारीख के बाद की जाए, एक "अभी खरीदें, बाद में भुगतान करें" किस्त योजना हो, या एक अल्पकालिक ऋण हो, बस शॉपिंग सूची को पूरा करने के लिए।

segments.src: For financial counselors, that's a meaningful shift.
segments.tr: वित्तीय सलाहकारों के लिए, यह एक महत्वपूर्ण बदलाव है।

segments.src: Back-to-school spending has traditionally been treated as a predictable, budgeted expense — closer to a utility bill than a financial emergency.
segments.tr: स्कूल के लिए खरीदारी परंपरागत रूप से एक अनुमानित, बजट किए गए खर्च के रूप में मानी जाती है — वित्तीय आपातकाल की तुलना में उपयोगिता बिल के करीब।

segments.src: When a routine seasonal purchase starts requiring borrowed money for a large share of households, it's often read as a signal of broader strain on discretionary budgets, not just a one-off spike in school supply prices.
segments.tr: जब एक नियमित मौसमी खरीद के लिए घरों के एक बड़े हिस्से को उधार ली गई राशि की जरूरत होने लगती है, तो इसे अक्सर विवेकाधीन बजट पर व्यापक तनाव के संकेत के रूप में देखा जाता है, न कि केवल स्कूल आपूर्ति की कीमतों में एकबारगी वृद्धि।

segments.src: ## Why This Year Is Being Called a Turning Point
segments.tr: ## क्यों इस साल को एक मोड़ कहा जा रहा है

segments.src: Economists who track consumer goods pricing note that this may be the first back-to-school season where the majority of a typical shopping list is made up of products directly affected by new tariff policy.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री जो उपभोक्ता वस्तुओं की कीमतें ट्रैक करते हैं, ध्यान दें कि यह स्कूल के लिए वापसी का पहला मौसम हो सकता है जहां एक विशिष्ट शॉपिंग सूची का अधिकांश भाग नई टैरिफ नीति से सीधे प्रभावित उत्पादों से बना है।

segments.src: In previous years, tariff impacts were more concentrated in specific categories, like electronics or certain apparel segments.
segments.tr: पिछले वर्षों में, टैरिफ के प्रभाव विशिष्ट श्रेणियों में अधिक केंद्रित थे, जैसे इलेक्ट्रॉनिक्स या कुछ वस्त्र खंड।

segments.src: This year, the breadth of affected goods — from paper products to footwear — means fewer families have an easy substitution available.
segments.tr: इस साल, प्रभावित सामानों की विस्तृत श्रेणी — कागज के उत्पादों से जूते तक — का मतलब है कि कम परिवारों के पास आसान विकल्प उपलब्ध है।

segments.src: That breadth is part of why the story has resonated beyond typical economic reporting.
segments.tr: यह विस्तृतता उस कारण का हिस्सा है कि यह कहानी सामान्य आर्थिक रिपोर्टिंग से परे गूंजी है।

segments.src: It isn't an abstract trade statistic; it shows up directly in a parent's total at the register.
segments.tr: यह एक अमूर्त व्यापार सांख्यिकी नहीं है; यह सीधे रजिस्टर पर माता-पिता की कुल राशि में दिखाई देता है।

segments.src: ## What Families Are Doing Differently
segments.tr: ## परिवार क्या अलग तरीके से कर रहे हैं

segments.src: Facing higher prices across nearly every category, many households are adjusting their shopping habits rather than simply absorbing the cost:
segments.tr: लगभग हर श्रेणी में अधिक कीमतों का सामना करते हुए, कई घरेलू लोग केवल लागत को सहन करने के बजाय अपनी खरीदारी की आदतों को समायोजित कर रहे हैं:

segments.src: - **Buying fewer items per category** and prioritizing what's absolutely required by the school's supply list.
segments.tr: - **प्रत्येक श्रेणी में कम वस्तुएं खरीदना** और स्कूल की सूची में बिल्कुल आवश्यक चीजों को प्राथमिकता देना।

segments.src: - **Shopping secondhand or swapping** clothing and supplies with other families.
segments.tr: - **दूसरे हाथ की खरीदारी या विनिमय** अन्य परिवारों के साथ कपड़े और आपूर्ति की।

segments.src: - **Spreading purchases out** across several weeks instead of one large shopping trip, to manage cash flow.
segments.tr: - **खरीद को कई हफ्तों में फैलाना** एक बड़ी खरीदारी यात्रा के बजाय, नकदी प्रवाह को प्रबंधित करने के लिए।

segments.src: - **Comparing store brands versus name brands** more aggressively than in past years.
segments.tr: - **स्टोर ब्रांड बनाम नाम ब्रांड की तुलना** पिछले वर्षों की तुलना में अधिक सक्रियता से करना।

segments.src: - **Using layaway or installment options** at retailers that offer them, rather than defaulting straight to a credit card.
segments.tr: - **लेयावे या किस्त विकल्प का उपयोग** उन खुदरा विक्रेताओं पर जो उन्हें प्रदान करते हैं, बजाय सीधे क्रेडिट कार्ड पर जाने के।

segments.src: Financial advisors generally caution that while short-term financing tools can help smooth a one-time expense, relying on revolving credit for a recurring annual cost like school shopping can create a cycle that's difficult to break, especially if next year's prices continue trending upward.
segments.tr: वित्तीय सलाहकार आमतौर पर चेतावनी देते हैं कि जबकि अल्पकालिक वित्तपोषण उपकरण एकबारगी खर्च को सुचारू करने में मदद कर सकते हैं, स्कूल की खरीदारी जैसे आवर्ती वार्षिक खर्च के लिए घूमने वाले क्रेडिट पर निर्भर रहना एक ऐसा चक्र बना सकता है जो तोड़ना मुश्किल हो, विशेषकर अगर अगले साल की कीमतें ऊपर की ओर बढ़ती रहें।

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## बड़ी तस्वीर

segments.src: Back-to-school spending is often treated as a bellwether for household financial health heading into the fall and holiday shopping season.
segments.tr: स्कूल के लिए वापसी की खरीदारी को अक्सर घरेलू वित्तीय स्वास्थ्य के संकेत के रूप में माना जाता है जो शरद ऋतु और छुट्टी के शॉपिंग सीजन में आ रहा है।

segments.src: If a growing share of families are financing routine purchases this early in the year, that trend is likely to draw closer attention from retailers, lenders, and policymakers alike in the months ahead.
segments.tr: यदि परिवारों का एक बढ़ता हिस्सा साल की शुरुआत में ही रूटीन खरीद को वित्तपोषण कर रहा है, तो यह प्रवृत्ति आने वाले महीनों में खुदरा विक्रेताओं, ऋणदाताओं, और नीति निर्माताओं का ध्यान आकर्षित करने की संभावना है।

segments.src: For now, though, the immediate reality for many parents is simpler and more pressing: get the list checked off, and figure out how to pay for it later.
segments.tr: लेकिन अभी के लिए, कई माता-पिता के लिए तत्काल वास्तविकता सरल और अधिक तात्कालिक है: सूची को पूरा करना, और बाद में इसके लिए भुगतान करने का तरीका निकालना।

es.title: El año escolar de $4,000: Cómo los aranceles convirtieron las compras de regreso a clases en una decisión de endeudamiento

segments.src: ## A Shopping List That Costs More Than It Used To
segments.tr: ## Una lista de compras que cuesta más que antes

segments.src: For millions of families, the ritual of back-to-school shopping has quietly turned into one of the biggest financial stress tests of the year.
segments.tr: Para millones de familias, el ritual de las compras de regreso a clases se ha convertido silenciosamente en una de las mayores pruebas de estrés financiero del año.

segments.src: Industry surveys tracking household spending now put the average cost of outfitting a single child for the new school year at close to $4,000 once tuition-adjacent costs, clothing, electronics, and everyday supplies are added together.
segments.tr: Las encuestas de la industria que rastrean el gasto de los hogares ahora sitúan el costo promedio de equipar a un solo niño para el nuevo año escolar cerca de $4,000 una vez que se suman los costos adyacentes a la matrícula, ropa, electrónica y suministros cotidianos.

segments.src: That figure has been climbing for several years, but this season feels different to a lot of parents — and the reason many point to is tariffs.
segments.tr: Esa cifra ha estado aumentando durante varios años, pero esta temporada se siente diferente para muchos padres —y la razón a la que muchos señalan son los aranceles.

segments.src: A wide share of the products that fill a typical school shopping cart — notebooks, backpacks, lunch boxes, sneakers, and basic apparel — are manufactured overseas and imported into the United States.
segments.tr: Una amplia proporción de los productos que llenan un carrito de compras típico de la escuela —cuadernos, mochilas, loncheras, zapatillas deportivas y prendas básicas— se fabrican en el extranjero y se importan a los Estados Unidos.

segments.src: When import tariffs rise on those categories, the added cost doesn't stay with the manufacturer or the importer for long.
segments.tr: Cuando los aranceles a la importación aumentan en esas categorías, el costo adicional no permanece con el fabricante o el importador durante mucho tiempo.

segments.src: It tends to move down the supply chain until it lands on a store shelf, and ultimately, in a parent's shopping cart.
segments.tr: Tiende a moverse hacia abajo en la cadena de suministro hasta que aterriza en un estante de tienda y, en última instancia, en el carrito de compras de un padre.

segments.src: ## Where the Price Increases Are Showing Up
segments.tr: ## Dónde se están viendo los aumentos de precios

segments.src: Retail analysts tracking this back-to-school season say the sharpest increases are concentrated in a handful of categories that were already price-sensitive for families:
segments.tr: Los analistas minoristas que rastrean esta temporada de regreso a clases dicen que los mayores aumentos se concentran en un puñado de categorías que ya eran sensibles al precio para las familias:

segments.src: - **School supplies** such as notebooks, binders, and basic stationery, many of which are produced in facilities affected by new tariff schedules.
segments.tr: - **Suministros escolares** como cuadernos, carpetas y artículos de papelería básicos, muchos de los cuales se producen en instalaciones afectadas por nuevos calendarios de aranceles.

segments.src: - **Lunch boxes and insulated bags**, a category dominated by imported goods with limited domestic manufacturing alternatives.
segments.tr: - **Loncheras y bolsas aisladas**, una categoría dominada por bienes importados con alternativas de fabricación nacional limitadas.

segments.src: - **Clothing and footwear**, where apparel tariffs have compounded with existing cost pressures from labor and shipping.
segments.tr: - **Ropa y calzado**, donde los aranceles sobre prendas se han combinado con presiones de costos existentes del trabajo y el envío.

segments.src: - **Basic electronics accessories**, including calculators, headphones, and chargers commonly required for middle and high school classes.
segments.tr: - **Accesorios electrónicos básicos**, incluidas calculadoras, auriculares y cargadores comúnmente requeridos para clases de secundaria y preparatoria.

segments.src: Several of these categories are reportedly seeing price increases in the double digits compared to last year, according to retail pricing trackers — a jump that is hard for many household budgets to absorb without some kind of trade-off.
segments.tr: Según los rastreadores de precios minoristas, varias de estas categorías están experimentando aumentos de precios de dos dígitos en comparación con el año pasado —un salto que es difícil de absorber para muchos presupuestos domésticos sin algún tipo de compensación.

segments.src: ## Nearly Half of Parents Say They'll Borrow to Cover It
segments.tr: ## Casi la mitad de los padres dicen que pedirán dinero prestado para cubrirlo

segments.src: What makes this year notable isn't just the price tag — it's how families say they plan to pay for it.
segments.tr: Lo que hace que este año sea notable no es solo el precio —es cómo dicen que las familias planean pagarlo.

segments.src: Recent consumer surveys suggest that nearly half of parents expect to rely on some form of credit, whether that's a credit card balance carried past the due date, a "buy now, pay later" installment plan, or a short-term loan, just to get through the shopping list.
segments.tr: Las encuestas de consumidores recientes sugieren que casi la mitad de los padres esperan depender de alguna forma de crédito, ya sea un saldo de tarjeta de crédito llevado después de la fecha de vencimiento, un plan de instalación "compra ahora, paga después", o un préstamo a corto plazo, solo para poder completar la lista de compras.

segments.src: For financial counselors, that's a meaningful shift.
segments.tr: Para los consejeros financieros, ese es un cambio significativo.

segments.src: Back-to-school spending has traditionally been treated as a predictable, budgeted expense — closer to a utility bill than a financial emergency.
segments.tr: El gasto de regreso a clases tradicionalmente ha sido tratado como un gasto predecible y presupuestado —más cercano a una factura de servicios que a una emergencia financiera.

segments.src: When a routine seasonal purchase starts requiring borrowed money for a large share of households, it's often read as a signal of broader strain on discretionary budgets, not just a one-off spike in school supply prices.
segments.tr: Cuando una compra estacional de rutina comienza a requerir dinero prestado para una gran parte de los hogares, a menudo se lee como una señal de una tensión más amplia en los presupuestos discrecionales, no solo un pico aislado en los precios de los suministros escolares.

segments.src: ## Why This Year Is Being Called a Turning Point
segments.tr: ## Por qué este año se está considerando un punto de inflexión

segments.src: Economists who track consumer goods pricing note that this may be the first back-to-school season where the majority of a typical shopping list is made up of products directly affected by new tariff policy.
segments.tr: Los economistas que rastrean los precios de los bienes de consumo señalan que esta puede ser la primera temporada de regreso a clases donde la mayoría de una lista de compras típica está compuesta por productos directamente afectados por la nueva política arancelaria.

segments.src: In previous years, tariff impacts were more concentrated in specific categories, like electronics or certain apparel segments.
segments.tr: En años anteriores, los impactos arancelarios eran más concentrados en categorías específicas, como la electrónica o ciertos segmentos de prendas.

segments.src: This year, the breadth of affected goods — from paper products to footwear — means fewer families have an easy substitution available.
segments.tr: Este año, la amplitud de los bienes afectados —desde productos de papel hasta calzado— significa que menos familias tienen una sustitución fácil disponible.

segments.src: That breadth is part of why the story has resonated beyond typical economic reporting.
segments.tr: Esa amplitud es parte de por qué la historia ha resonado más allá del reportaje económico típico.

segments.src: It isn't an abstract trade statistic; it shows up directly in a parent's total at the register.
segments.tr: No es una estadística comercial abstracta; aparece directamente en el total de un padre en la caja.

segments.src: ## What Families Are Doing Differently
segments.tr: ## Lo que las familias están haciendo diferente

segments.src: Facing higher prices across nearly every category, many households are adjusting their shopping habits rather than simply absorbing the cost:
segments.tr: Enfrentando precios más altos en casi todas las categorías, muchos hogares están ajustando sus hábitos de compra en lugar de simplemente absorber el costo:

segments.src: - **Buying fewer items per category** and prioritizing what's absolutely required by the school's supply list.
segments.tr: - **Comprar menos artículos por categoría** y priorizar lo que sea absolutamente requerido por la lista de suministros de la escuela.

segments.src: - **Shopping secondhand or swapping** clothing and supplies with other families.
segments.tr: - **Comprar de segunda mano o intercambiar** ropa y suministros con otras familias.

segments.src: - **Spreading purchases out** across several weeks instead of one large shopping trip, to manage cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Distribuir las compras** a lo largo de varias semanas en lugar de un viaje de compras grande, para gestionar el flujo de caja.

segments.src: - **Comparing store brands versus name brands** more aggressively than in past years.
segments.tr: - **Comparar marcas de tienda versus marcas reconocidas** más agresivamente que en años anteriores.

segments.src: - **Using layaway or installment options** at retailers that offer them, rather than defaulting straight to a credit card.
segments.tr: - **Usar opciones de reserva o instalación** en minoristas que las ofrecen, en lugar de optar directamente por una tarjeta de crédito.

segments.src: Financial advisors generally caution that while short-term financing tools can help smooth a one-time expense, relying on revolving credit for a recurring annual cost like school shopping can create a cycle that's difficult to break, especially if next year's prices continue trending upward.
segments.tr: Los asesores financieros generalmente advierten que si bien las herramientas de financiamiento a corto plazo pueden ayudar a suavizar un gasto único, depender del crédito renovable para un costo anual recurrente como las compras escolares puede crear un ciclo que es difícil de romper, especialmente si los precios del próximo año continúan tendiendo hacia arriba.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## La perspectiva más amplia

segments.src: Back-to-school spending is often treated as a bellwether for household financial health heading into the fall and holiday shopping season.
segments.tr: El gasto de regreso a clases a menudo se trata como un indicador de la salud financiera del hogar que se dirige hacia la temporada de otoño y compras navideñas.

segments.src: If a growing share of families are financing routine purchases this early in the year, that trend is likely to draw closer attention from retailers, lenders, and policymakers alike in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Si una proporción creciente de familias están financiando compras de rutina tan temprano en el año, esa tendencia probablemente atraerá una atención más cercana de minoristas, prestamistas y legisladores por igual en los meses venideros.

segments.src: For now, though, the immediate reality for many parents is simpler and more pressing: get the list checked off, and figure out how to pay for it later.
segments.tr: Por ahora, sin embargo, la realidad inmediata para muchos padres es más simple y más apremiante: marcar la lista completada y descubrir cómo pagarla más tarde.

segments.src: When import tariffs rise on those categories, the added cost doesn't stay with the manufacturer or the importer for long.
segments.tr: عندما ترتفع الرسوم الجمركية على الاستيراد لتلك الفئات، لا تبقى التكلفة الإضافية مع المصنع أو المستورد لفترة طويلة.

segments.src: It tends to move down the supply chain until it lands on a store shelf, and ultimately, in a parent's shopping cart.
segments.tr: تميل إلى الانتقال نحو الأسفل عبر سلسلة التوريد حتى تصل إلى رف متجر، وفي النهاية، إلى سلة تسوق الوالد.

segments.tr: Ce qui rend cette année remarquable n'est pas seulement le prix — c'est comment les familles disent qu'elles prévoient de payer.

segments.src: Recent consumer surveys suggest that nearly half of parents expect to rely on some form of credit, whether that's a credit card balance carried past the due date, a "buy now, pay later" installment plan, or a short-term loan, just to get through the shopping list.
segments.tr: Les récentes enquêtes auprès des consommateurs suggèrent que près de la moitié des parents s'attendent à dépendre d'une forme de crédit, qu'il s'agisse d'un solde de carte de crédit reporté après l'échéance, d'un plan de paiement échelonné « acheter maintenant, payer plus tard » ou d'un prêt à court terme, juste pour passer à travers la liste d'achats.

segments.src: For financial counselors, that's a meaningful shift.
segments.tr: Pour les conseillers financiers, c'est un changement significatif.

segments.src: Back-to-school spending has traditionally been treated as a predictable, budgeted expense — closer to a utility bill than a financial emergency.
segments.tr: Les dépenses de rentrée ont traditionnellement été traitées comme une dépense prévisible et budgétisée — plus proches d'une facture de services que d'une urgence financière.

segments.src: When a routine seasonal purchase starts requiring borrowed money for a large share of households, it's often read as a signal of broader strain on discretionary budgets, not just a one-off spike in school supply prices.
segments.tr: Lorsqu'un achat saisonnier de routine commence à nécessiter de l'argent emprunté pour une grande part des ménages, c'est souvent lu comme un signal d'une plus grande tension sur les budgets discrétionnaires, pas seulement une augmentation ponctuelle des prix des fournitures scolaires.

segments.src: ## Why This Year Is Being Called a Turning Point
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cette année est considérée comme un tournant

segments.src: Economists who track consumer goods pricing note that this may be the first back-to-school season where the majority of a typical shopping list is made up of products directly affected by new tariff policy.
segments.tr: Les économistes qui suivent les prix des biens de consommation notent que cela peut être la première saison de rentrée où la majorité d'une liste d'achats typique est composée de produits directement affectés par la nouvelle politique tarifaire.

segments.src: In previous years, tariff impacts were more concentrated in specific categories, like electronics or certain apparel segments.
segments.tr: Les années précédentes, les impacts tarifaires étaient plus concentrés dans des catégories spécifiques, comme l'électronique ou certains segments de vêtements.

segments.src: This year, the breadth of affected goods — from paper products to footwear — means fewer families have an easy substitution available.
segments.tr: Cette année, l'étendue des biens affectés — des produits papetiers aux chaussures — signifie que moins de familles ont une substitution facile disponible.

segments.src: That breadth is part of why the story has resonated beyond typical economic reporting.
segments.tr: Cette étendue est en partie la raison pour laquelle l'histoire a résonné au-delà des rapports économiques typiques.

segments.src: It isn't an abstract trade statistic; it shows up directly in a parent's total at the register.
segments.tr: Ce n'est pas une statistique commerciale abstraite; c'est directement visible au total du registre d'un parent.

segments.src: ## What Families Are Doing Differently
segments.tr: ## Ce que les familles font différemment

segments.src: Facing higher prices across nearly every category, many households are adjusting their shopping habits rather than simply absorbing the cost:
segments.tr: Face à des prix plus élevés dans presque toutes les catégories, de nombreux ménages ajustent leurs habitudes d'achat plutôt que d'absorber simplement le coût :

segments.src: - **Buying fewer items per category** and prioritizing what's absolutely required by the school's supply list.
segments.tr: - **Acheter moins d'articles par catégorie** et prioriser ce qui est absolument requis par la liste de fournitures de l'école.

segments.src: - **Shopping secondhand or swapping** clothing and supplies with other families.
segments.tr: - **Faire du shopping d'occasion ou échanger** des vêtements et des fournitures avec d'autres familles.

segments.src: - **Spreading purchases out** across several weeks instead of one large shopping trip, to manage cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Étaler les achats** sur plusieurs semaines au lieu d'un grand voyage d'achat, pour gérer les flux de trésorerie.

segments.src: - **Comparing store brands versus name brands** more aggressively than in past years.
segments.tr: - **Comparer les marques de magasin par rapport aux marques prestigieuses** plus agressivement que les années précédentes.

segments.src: - **Using layaway or installment options** at retailers that offer them, rather than defaulting straight to a credit card.
segments.tr: - **Utiliser les options de mise de côté ou de paiement échelonné** chez les détaillants qui les proposent, plutôt que de se tourner directement vers une carte de crédit.

segments.src: Financial advisors generally caution that while short-term financing tools can help smooth a one-time expense, relying on revolving credit for a recurring annual cost like school shopping can create a cycle that's difficult to break, especially if next year's prices continue trending upward.
segments.tr: Les conseillers financiers mettent généralement en garde le fait que si les outils de financement à court terme peuvent aider à lisser une dépense ponctuelle, se fier au crédit renouvelable pour un coût annuel récurrent comme le shopping scolaire peut créer un cycle difficile à briser, surtout si les prix de l'année prochaine continuent d'augmenter.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## La vue d'ensemble

segments.src: Back-to-school spending is often treated as a bellwether for household financial health heading into the fall and holiday shopping season.
segments.tr: Les dépenses de rentrée sont souvent traitées comme un baromètre de la santé financière des ménages en se dirigeant vers la saison automnale et des achats des fêtes.

segments.src: If a growing share of families are financing routine purchases this early in the year, that trend is likely to draw closer attention from retailers, lenders, and policymakers alike in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Si une part croissante de familles financent des achats de routine si tôt dans l'année, cette tendance attirera probablement une plus grande attention des détaillants, des prêteurs et des décideurs politiques dans les mois à venir.

segments.src: For now, though, the immediate reality for many parents is simpler and more pressing: get the list checked off, and figure out how to pay for it later.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, cependant, la réalité immédiate pour de nombreux parents est plus simple et plus urgente : cocher la liste et déterminer comment la payer plus tard.

pt.title: O Ano Escolar de $4,000: Como as Tarifas Transformaram as Compras de Volta às Aulas em uma Decisão de Dívida

segments.src: ## A Shopping List That Costs More Than It Used To
segments.tr: ## Uma Lista de Compras Que Custa Mais Do Que Costumava

segments.src: For millions of families, the ritual of back-to-school shopping has quietly turned into one of the biggest financial stress tests of the year.
segments.tr: Para milhões de famílias, o ritual de compras de volta às aulas se transformou silenciosamente em um dos maiores testes de estresse financeiro do ano.

segments.src: Industry surveys tracking household spending now put the average cost of outfitting a single child for the new school year at close to $4,000 once tuition-adjacent costs, clothing, electronics, and everyday supplies are added together.
segments.tr: Pesquisas do setor que rastreiam gastos domésticos agora colocam o custo médio de equipar uma única criança para o novo ano escolar em cerca de $4,000 quando custos relacionados a mensalidades, roupas, eletrônicos e suprimentos diários são somados.

segments.src: That figure has been climbing for several years, but this season feels different to a lot of parents — and the reason many point to is tariffs.
segments.tr: Esse número está subindo há vários anos, mas esta temporada se sente diferente para muitos pais — e a razão que muitos apontam são as tarifas.

segments.src: A wide share of the products that fill a typical school shopping cart — notebooks, backpacks, lunch boxes, sneakers, and basic apparel — are manufactured overseas and imported into the United States.
segments.tr: Uma grande parte dos produtos que preenchem um carrinho de compras escolar típico — cadernos, mochilas, lancheiras, tênis e roupas básicas — são fabricados no exterior e importados para os Estados Unidos.

segments.src: When import tariffs rise on those categories, the added cost doesn't stay with the manufacturer or the importer for long.
segments.tr: Quando as tarifas de importação aumentam nessas categorias, o custo adicional não permanece com o fabricante ou o importador por muito tempo.

segments.src: It tends to move down the supply chain until it lands on a store shelf, and ultimately, in a parent's shopping cart.
segments.tr: Tende a descer na cadeia de suprimentos até pousar na prateleira de uma loja e, em última análise, no carrinho de compras de um pai.

segments.src: ## Where the Price Increases Are Showing Up
segments.tr: ## Onde os Aumentos de Preço Estão Aparecendo

segments.src: Retail analysts tracking this back-to-school season say the sharpest increases are concentrated in a handful of categories that were already price-sensitive for families:
segments.tr: Analistas de varejo que rastreiam esta temporada de volta às aulas dizem que os maiores aumentos de preço estão concentrados em um punhado de categorias que já eram sensíveis ao preço para as famílias:

segments.src: - **School supplies** such as notebooks, binders, and basic stationery, many of which are produced in facilities affected by new tariff schedules.
segments.tr: - **Material escolar** como cadernos, pastas e papelaria básica, muitos dos quais são produzidos em instalações afetadas pelas novas tabelas de tarifas.

segments.src: - **Lunch boxes and insulated bags**, a category dominated by imported goods with limited domestic manufacturing alternatives.
segments.tr: - **Lancheiras e bolsas térmicas**, uma categoria dominada por bens importados com alternativas limitadas de fabricação doméstica.

segments.src: - **Clothing and footwear**, where apparel tariffs have compounded with existing cost pressures from labor and shipping.
segments.tr: - **Roupas e calçados**, onde as tarifas de vestuário se combinaram com pressões de custos existentes de mão de obra e envio.

segments.src: - **Basic electronics accessories**, including calculators, headphones, and chargers commonly required for middle and high school classes.
segments.tr: - **Acessórios eletrônicos básicos**, incluindo calculadoras, fones de ouvido e carregadores comumente necessários para aulas de ensino fundamental e médio.

segments.src: Several of these categories are reportedly seeing price increases in the double digits compared to last year, according to retail pricing trackers — a jump that is hard for many household budgets to absorb without some kind of trade-off.
segments.tr: Várias dessas categorias estão vendo aumentos de preço em dois dígitos em comparação com o ano passado, de acordo com rastreadores de preços de varejo — um salto difícil para muitos orçamentos domésticos absorverem sem algum tipo de compensação.

segments.src: ## Nearly Half of Parents Say They'll Borrow to Cover It
segments.tr: ## Quase Metade dos Pais Diz Que Vai Pegar Emprestado para Cobrir

segments.tr: O que torna este ano notável não é apenas o preço — é como as famílias dizem que planejam pagá-lo.

segments.src: Recent consumer surveys suggest that nearly half of parents expect to rely on some form of credit, whether that's a credit card balance carried past the due date, a "buy now, pay later" installment plan, or a short-term loan, just to get through the shopping list.
segments.tr: Pesquisas recentes de consumidores sugerem que quase metade dos pais espera contar com alguma forma de crédito, seja um saldo do cartão de crédito carregado além da data de vencimento, um plano de parcelamento "compre agora, pague depois" ou um empréstimo de curto prazo, apenas para passar pela lista de compras.

segments.src: For financial counselors, that's a meaningful shift.
segments.tr: Para conselheiros financeiros, essa é uma mudança significativa.

segments.tr: Os gastos com volta às aulas foram tradicionalmente tratados como uma despesa previsível e orçada — mais próxima de uma conta de serviço público do que de uma emergência financeira.

segments.src: When a routine seasonal purchase starts requiring borrowed money for a large share of households, it's often read as a signal of broader strain on discretionary budgets, not just a one-off spike in school supply prices.
segments.tr: Quando uma compra sazonal de rotina começa a exigir dinheiro emprestado para uma grande parcela de domicílios, geralmente é lida como um sinal de pressão mais ampla nos orçamentos discricionários, não apenas um pico único nos preços do material escolar.

segments.tr: ## Por Que Este Ano Está Sendo Chamado de Ponto de Virada

segments.tr: Economistas que rastreiam preços de bens de consumo observam que esta pode ser a primeira temporada de volta às aulas onde a maioria de uma lista de compras típica é composta por produtos diretamente afetados pela nova política tarifária.

segments.tr: Em anos anteriores, os impactos tarifários eram mais concentrados em categorias específicas, como eletrônicos ou certos segmentos de vestuário.

segments.src: This year, the breadth of affected goods — from paper products to footwear — means fewer families have an easy substitution available.
segments.tr: Este ano, a amplitude dos bens afetados — de produtos de papel a calçados — significa que menos famílias têm uma substituição fácil disponível.

segments.src: That breadth is part of why the story has resonated beyond typical economic reporting.
segments.tr: Essa amplitude é parte do motivo pelo qual a história ressoou além do relatório econômico típico.

segments.tr: ## O Que as Famílias Estão Fazendo Diferentemente

segments.tr: - **Comprar menos itens por categoria** e priorizar o que é absolutamente necessário pela lista de suprimentos da escola.

segments.src: - **Shopping secondhand or swapping** clothing and supplies with other families.

segments.src: - **Spreading purchases out** across several weeks instead of one large shopping trip, to manage cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Distribuir compras** ao longo de várias semanas em vez de uma única grande compra, para gerenciar o fluxo de caixa.

segments.src: - **Comparing store brands versus name brands** more aggressively than in past years.

segments.src: - **Using layaway or installment options** at retailers that offer them, rather than defaulting straight to a credit card.

segments.src: Industry surveys tracking household spending now put the average cost of outfitting a single child for the new school year at close to $4,000 once tuition-adjacent costs, clothing, electronics, and everyday supplies are added together.
segments.tr: Survei industri yang melacak pengeluaran rumah tangga kini menempatkan biaya rata-rata untuk melengkapi seorang anak untuk tahun sekolah baru pada sekitar $4,000 setelah biaya terkait tuition, pakaian, elektronik, dan perlengkapan sehari-hari dijumlahkan.

segments.tr: Angka tersebut telah meningkat selama beberapa tahun, tetapi musim ini terasa berbeda bagi banyak orang tua — dan alasan yang banyak disorot adalah tarif.

segments.src: ## Where the Price Increases Are Showing Up

segments.tr: - **Kotak makan siang dan tas berinsulasi**, sebuah kategori yang didominasi oleh barang-barang impor dengan alternatif manufaktur domestik yang terbatas.

segments.src: Recent consumer surveys suggest that nearly half of parents expect to rely on some form of credit, whether that's a credit card balance carried past the due date, a "buy now, pay later" installment plan, or a short-term loan, just to get through the shopping list.

segments.src: When a routine seasonal purchase starts requiring borrowed money for a large share of households, it's often read as a signal of broader strain on discretionary budgets, not just a one-off spike in school supply prices.
segments.tr: Ketika pembelian musiman rutin mulai memerlukan uang pinjaman untuk sebagian besar rumah tangga, itu sering dibaca sebagai sinyal ketegangan yang lebih luas pada anggaran kebijaksanaan, bukan hanya lonjakan satu kali dalam harga perlengkapan sekolah.

segments.src: ## Why This Year Is Being Called a Turning Point
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Tahun Ini Disebut Titik Balik

segments.src: That breadth is part of why the story has resonated beyond typical economic reporting.

segments.src: ## What Families Are Doing Differently
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Keluarga Lakukan Berbeda

segments.src: Facing higher prices across nearly every category, many households are adjusting their shopping habits rather than simply absorbing the cost:
segments.tr: Menghadapi harga yang lebih tinggi di hampir setiap kategori, banyak rumah tangga menyesuaikan kebiasaan belanja mereka daripada sekadar menyerap biaya:

segments.src: - **Shopping secondhand or swapping** clothing and supplies with other families.

ja.title: $4,000の学年：関税がいかに学年度開始時のショッピングを債務決定に変えたか

segments.src: ## A Shopping List That Costs More Than It Used To
segments.tr: ## 以前よりもコストがかかるショッピングリスト

segments.src: For millions of families, the ritual of back-to-school shopping has quietly turned into one of the biggest financial stress tests of the year.
segments.tr: 何百万もの家族にとって、学年度開始時のショッピングという慣習は、静かに年間最大の経済的ストレステストの1つになってしまいました。

segments.src: Industry surveys tracking household spending now put the average cost of outfitting a single child for the new school year at close to $4,000 once tuition-adjacent costs, clothing, electronics, and everyday supplies are added together.
segments.tr: 世帯支出を追跡する業界調査では、授業料関連費用、衣類、電子機器、日用品をすべて合わせると、1人の子どもを新学年に向けて準備するための平均費用は$4,000近くになっています。

segments.src: That figure has been climbing for several years, but this season feels different to a lot of parents — and the reason many point to is tariffs.
segments.tr: その数字は数年間上昇し続けていますが、この季節は多くの親にとって異なるように感じられます。そして多くの親が指摘する理由は関税です。

segments.src: A wide share of the products that fill a typical school shopping cart — notebooks, backpacks, lunch boxes, sneakers, and basic apparel — are manufactured overseas and imported into the United States.
segments.tr: 典型的なスクールショッピングカートを満たす製品の大部分——ノート、バックパック、ランチボックス、スニーカー、基本的な衣類——は海外で製造され、米国にインポートされています。

segments.src: When import tariffs rise on those categories, the added cost doesn't stay with the manufacturer or the importer for long.
segments.tr: これらのカテゴリーに対する輸入関税が上昇すると、追加費用は製造業者または輸入業者に長くとどまりません。

segments.src: It tends to move down the supply chain until it lands on a store shelf, and ultimately, in a parent's shopping cart.
segments.tr: それはサプライチェーンを下って移動し、最終的には店棚に、そして結局、親のショッピングカートに到達します。

segments.src: ## Where the Price Increases Are Showing Up
segments.tr: ## 価格上昇が現れている場所

segments.src: Retail analysts tracking this back-to-school season say the sharpest increases are concentrated in a handful of categories that were already price-sensitive for families:
segments.tr: この学年度開始時の季節を追跡する小売分析家は、最も急激な上昇は既に家族にとって価格に敏感であったいくつかのカテゴリーに集中していると述べています:

segments.src: - **School supplies** such as notebooks, binders, and basic stationery, many of which are produced in facilities affected by new tariff schedules.
segments.tr: - **学用品**：ノート、バインダー、基本的な文房具など、その多くが新しい関税スケジュールの影響を受けた施設で生産されています。

segments.src: - **Lunch boxes and insulated bags**, a category dominated by imported goods with limited domestic manufacturing alternatives.
segments.tr: - **ランチボックスと断熱バッグ**：国内製造の代替案が限定されている輸入品に支配されたカテゴリー。

segments.src: - **Clothing and footwear**, where apparel tariffs have compounded with existing cost pressures from labor and shipping.
segments.tr: - **衣類と履物**：衣料品関税が労働力と配送からの既存の費用圧力と複合化している分野。

segments.src: - **Basic electronics accessories**, including calculators, headphones, and chargers commonly required for middle and high school classes.
segments.tr: - **基本的な電子アクセサリー**：電卓、ヘッドフォン、中学校と高校のクラスで一般的に必要とされる充電器を含む。

segments.src: Several of these categories are reportedly seeing price increases in the double digits compared to last year, according to retail pricing trackers — a jump that is hard for many household budgets to absorb without some kind of trade-off.
segments.tr: 小売価格追跡システムによると、これらのカテゴリーのいくつかは昨年と比較して2桁の価格上昇を見ていると報告されています——多くの世帯予算が何らかのトレードオフなしに吸収するのが難しい上昇です。

segments.src: ## Nearly Half of Parents Say They'll Borrow to Cover It
segments.tr: ## ほぼ半数の親が費用をカバーするために借りると言っています

segments.src: What makes this year notable isn't just the price tag — it's how families say they plan to pay for it.
segments.tr: この年を注目すべきものにしているのは単なる価格ではありません——それは家族がそれをどのように支払う計画について言うかです。

segments.src: Recent consumer surveys suggest that nearly half of parents expect to rely on some form of credit, whether that's a credit card balance carried past the due date, a "buy now, pay later" installment plan, or a short-term loan, just to get through the shopping list.
segments.tr: 最近の消費者調査では、ほぼ半数の親がクレジット形態に依存することが予想されます。期限を過ぎて保持されているクレジットカード残高であれ、「今すぐ購入、後で支払う」分割払いプランであれ、短期ローンであれ、単にショッピングリストを通すためです。

segments.src: For financial counselors, that's a meaningful shift.
segments.tr: ファイナンシャルカウンセラーにとって、それは意味のある変化です。

segments.src: Back-to-school spending has traditionally been treated as a predictable, budgeted expense — closer to a utility bill than a financial emergency.
segments.tr: 学年度開始時の支出は伝統的に、予測可能な予算費用として扱われてきました——経済的緊急事態よりもユーティリティビルに近いものです。

segments.src: When a routine seasonal purchase starts requiring borrowed money for a large share of households, it's often read as a signal of broader strain on discretionary budgets, not just a one-off spike in school supply prices.
segments.tr: 定常的な季節購入が多くの世帯のために借りたお金を必要とし始めるとき、それはしばしば裁量予算の広範な負担の信号として読まれます。単なる学用品価格の1回限りのスパイクではなく。

segments.src: ## Why This Year Is Being Called a Turning Point
segments.tr: ## なぜこの年がターニングポイントと呼ばれているのか

segments.src: Economists who track consumer goods pricing note that this may be the first back-to-school season where the majority of a typical shopping list is made up of products directly affected by new tariff policy.
segments.tr: 消費財価格を追跡する経済学者は、これが典型的なショッピングリストの大部分が新しい関税政策の直接的な影響を受けた製品で構成される最初の学年度開始時の季節かもしれないと指摘しています。

segments.src: In previous years, tariff impacts were more concentrated in specific categories, like electronics or certain apparel segments.
segments.tr: 前年は、関税の影響はより特定のカテゴリー——電子機器や特定の衣料品セグメント——に集中していました。

segments.src: This year, the breadth of affected goods — from paper products to footwear — means fewer families have an easy substitution available.
segments.tr: 今年、影響を受けた商品の広さ——紙製品から履物まで——は、より少ない家族が簡単な代替品を利用できることを意味します。

segments.src: That breadth is part of why the story has resonated beyond typical economic reporting.
segments.tr: その広さが、このストーリーが典型的な経済報告を超えて共鳴した理由の一部です。

segments.src: It isn't an abstract trade statistic; it shows up directly in a parent's total at the register.
segments.tr: それは抽象的な貿易統計ではありません。それはレジスターで親の合計に直接現れます。

segments.src: ## What Families Are Doing Differently
segments.tr: ## 家族が異なることをしていること

segments.src: Facing higher prices across nearly every category, many households are adjusting their shopping habits rather than simply absorbing the cost:
segments.tr: ほぼすべてのカテゴリーでより高い価格に直面して、多くの世帯は単に費用を吸収するのではなく、彼らのショッピング習慣を調整しています:

segments.src: - **Buying fewer items per category** and prioritizing what's absolutely required by the school's supply list.
segments.tr: - **カテゴリーごとにより少ない項目を購入**し、学校の供給リストで絶対に必要とされるものを優先する。

segments.src: - **Shopping secondhand or swapping** clothing and supplies with other families.
segments.tr: - **中古品で買い物をしたり、交換したり**、他の家族と衣類と用品を交換する。

segments.src: - **Spreading purchases out** across several weeks instead of one large shopping trip, to manage cash flow.
segments.tr: - **購入を複数の週にわたって広げ**、1つの大きなショッピング旅行の代わりに、キャッシュフローを管理する。

segments.src: - **Comparing store brands versus name brands** more aggressively than in past years.
segments.tr: - **ストアブランドと名ブランドを比較**、過去の年よりもより積極的に。

segments.src: - **Using layaway or installment options** at retailers that offer them, rather than defaulting straight to a credit card.
segments.tr: - **先払い契約または分割払いオプションを使用**、クレジットカードに直接デフォルトするのではなく、それらを提供する小売業者で。

segments.src: Financial advisors generally caution that while short-term financing tools can help smooth a one-time expense, relying on revolving credit for a recurring annual cost like school shopping can create a cycle that's difficult to break, especially if next year's prices continue trending upward.
segments.tr: ファイナンシャルアドバイザーは一般的に注意を促しています。短期融資ツールは1回限りの費用をスムーズにするのに役立つ一方で、学校ショッピングのような繰り返される年間費用のために回転信用に依存することは、破るのが難しいサイクルを作成できます。特に来年の価格が上昇傾向を続ける場合は。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## より大きな全体像

segments.src: Back-to-school spending is often treated as a bellwether for household financial health heading into the fall and holiday shopping season.
segments.tr: 学年度開始時の支出は、秋と休日のショッピング季節に向かう世帯の経済的健康の先行指標として扱われることが多いです。

segments.src: If a growing share of families are financing routine purchases this early in the year, that trend is likely to draw closer attention from retailers, lenders, and policymakers alike in the months ahead.
segments.tr: 年間のこの早い段階で定常的な購入に資金を提供している家族の増加するシェアがある場合、その傾向は今後数ヶ月間で小売業者、貸し手、政策立案者からより密接な注目を集ける可能性があります。

segments.src: For now, though, the immediate reality for many parents is simpler and more pressing: get the list checked off, and figure out how to pay for it later.
segments.tr: 今のところ、しかし、多くの親にとっての直接的な現実はより単純でより緊急です：リストをチェックオフにして、後でそれにお金を払う方法を理解する。

segments.tr: Für jetzt aber ist die unmittelbare Realität für viele Eltern einfacher und dringender: die Liste abhaken und später herausfinden, wie man dafür bezahlt.

vi.title: Năm học $4,000: Làm thế nào thuế quan đã biến việc mua sắm chuẩn bị cho năm học mới thành một quyết định nợ

segments.src: ## A Shopping List That Costs More Than It Used To
segments.tr: ## Danh sách mua sắm có giá cao hơn trước

segments.src: For millions of families, the ritual of back-to-school shopping has quietly turned into one of the biggest financial stress tests of the year.
segments.tr: Đối với hàng triệu gia đình, nghi lễ mua sắm chuẩn bị cho năm học mới đã âm thầm trở thành một trong những bài kiểm tra áp lực tài chính lớn nhất của năm.

segments.src: Industry surveys tracking household spending now put the average cost of outfitting a single child for the new school year at close to $4,000 once tuition-adjacent costs, clothing, electronics, and everyday supplies are added together.
segments.tr: Các cuộc khảo sát ngành theo dõi chi tiêu hộ gia đình hiện đặt chi phí trung bình để trang bị cho một trẻ em cho năm học mới gần $4,000 khi cộng thêm chi phí liên quan đến học phí, quần áo, điện tử và các nhu yếu phẩm hàng ngày.

segments.src: That figure has been climbing for several years, but this season feels different to a lot of parents — and the reason many point to is tariffs.
segments.tr: Con số này đã tăng trong vài năm, nhưng mùa này cảm thấy khác biệt với nhiều bậc cha mẹ — và lý do mà nhiều người chỉ ra là thuế quan.

segments.src: A wide share of the products that fill a typical school shopping cart — notebooks, backpacks, lunch boxes, sneakers, and basic apparel — are manufactured overseas and imported into the United States.
segments.tr: Một phần lớn các sản phẩm điền vào giỏ hàng mua sắm trường học điển hình — vở ghi chép, balo, hộp cơm trưa, giày sneaker và quần áo cơ bản — được sản xuất ở nước ngoài và nhập khẩu vào Hoa Kỳ.

segments.src: When import tariffs rise on those categories, the added cost doesn't stay with the manufacturer or the importer for long.
segments.tr: Khi thuế nhập khẩu tăng đối với những danh mục đó, chi phí bổ sung không lâu sẽ di chuyển khỏi nhà sản xuất hoặc nhà nhập khẩu.

segments.src: It tends to move down the supply chain until it lands on a store shelf, and ultimately, in a parent's shopping cart.
segments.tr: Nó có xu hướng di chuyển xuống chuỗi cung ứng cho đến khi nó đến trên kệ cửa hàng, và cuối cùng, trong giỏ hàng của cha mẹ.

segments.src: ## Where the Price Increases Are Showing Up
segments.tr: ## Nơi tăng giá đang xuất hiện

segments.src: Retail analysts tracking this back-to-school season say the sharpest increases are concentrated in a handful of categories that were already price-sensitive for families:
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích bán lẻ theo dõi mùa chuẩn bị năm học mới này cho biết những tăng giá sốc nhất tập trung trong một vài danh mục đã nhạy cảm về giá đối với các gia đình:

segments.src: - **School supplies** such as notebooks, binders, and basic stationery, many of which are produced in facilities affected by new tariff schedules.
segments.tr: - **Dụng cụ học tập** chẳng hạn như vở ghi chép, bìa đựng tài liệu, và bút viết cơ bản, nhiều trong số đó được sản xuất ở các cơ sở bị ảnh hưởng bởi lịch biểu thuế mới.

segments.src: - **Lunch boxes and insulated bags**, a category dominated by imported goods with limited domestic manufacturing alternatives.
segments.tr: - **Hộp cơm trưa và túi giữ nhiệt**, một danh mục được chi phối bởi các hàng hóa nhập khẩu với các lựa chọn sản xuất trong nước hạn chế.

segments.src: - **Clothing and footwear**, where apparel tariffs have compounded with existing cost pressures from labor and shipping.
segments.tr: - **Quần áo và giày dép**, nơi thuế quan quần áo đã kết hợp với áp lực chi phí hiện có từ lao động và vận chuyển.

segments.src: - **Basic electronics accessories**, including calculators, headphones, and chargers commonly required for middle and high school classes.
segments.tr: - **Phụ kiện điện tử cơ bản**, bao gồm máy tính, tai nghe và bộ sạc thường được yêu cầu cho các lớp trung học cơ sở và trung học phổ thông.

segments.src: Several of these categories are reportedly seeing price increases in the double digits compared to last year, according to retail pricing trackers — a jump that is hard for many household budgets to absorb without some kind of trade-off.
segments.tr: Theo báo cáo, một số danh mục này đang chứng kiến những tăng giá hai chữ số so với năm ngoái, theo các công cụ theo dõi giá bán lẻ — một mức tăng khó khăn cho nhiều ngân sách hộ gia đình để hấp thụ mà không có sự đánh đổi nào.

segments.src: ## Nearly Half of Parents Say They'll Borrow to Cover It
segments.tr: ## Gần nửa số cha mẹ nói họ sẽ vay để chi trả

segments.src: What makes this year notable isn't just the price tag — it's how families say they plan to pay for it.
segments.tr: Điều làm cho năm nay đáng chú ý không chỉ là giá — mà là cách các gia đình nói rằng họ dự định trả tiền cho nó.

segments.src: Recent consumer surveys suggest that nearly half of parents expect to rely on some form of credit, whether that's a credit card balance carried past the due date, a "buy now, pay later" installment plan, or a short-term loan, just to get through the shopping list.
segments.tr: Các cuộc khảo sát tiêu dùng gần đây cho thấy rằng gần nửa số bậc cha mẹ dự kiến sẽ phụ thuộc vào một số hình thức tín dụng, cho dù đó là số dư thẻ tín dụng ghi nợ quá hạn, kế hoạch trả góp "mua bây giờ, trả sau", hoặc khoản vay ngắn hạn, chỉ để vượt qua danh sách mua sắm.

segments.src: For financial counselors, that's a meaningful shift.
segments.tr: Đối với các cố vấn tài chính, đó là một sự thay đổi có ý nghĩa.

segments.src: Back-to-school spending has traditionally been treated as a predictable, budgeted expense — closer to a utility bill than a financial emergency.
segments.tr: Chi tiêu chuẩn bị năm học mới theo truyền thống đã được coi là một khoản chi phí dự báo được, được lập ngân sách — gần như một hóa đơn tiện ích hơn là một cuộc khủng hoảng tài chính.

segments.src: When a routine seasonal purchase starts requiring borrowed money for a large share of households, it's often read as a signal of broader strain on discretionary budgets, not just a one-off spike in school supply prices.
segments.tr: Khi một lần mua hàng theo mùa thường xuyên bắt đầu yêu cầu tiền vay cho một phần lớn hộ gia đình, nó thường được đọc như một tín hiệu của căng thẳng rộng hơn trên các ngân sách tự do, không chỉ là một sự tăng đột ngột trong giá dụng cụ học tập.

segments.src: ## Why This Year Is Being Called a Turning Point
segments.tr: ## Tại sao năm nay được gọi là một điểm gãy

segments.src: Economists who track consumer goods pricing note that this may be the first back-to-school season where the majority of a typical shopping list is made up of products directly affected by new tariff policy.
segments.tr: Các nhà kinh tế học theo dõi giá hàng tiêu dùng lưu ý rằng đây có thể là mùa chuẩn bị năm học mới đầu tiên nơi phần lớn danh sách mua sắm điển hình được tạo thành từ các sản phẩm chịu ảnh hưởng trực tiếp bởi chính sách thuế mới.

segments.src: In previous years, tariff impacts were more concentrated in specific categories, like electronics or certain apparel segments.
segments.tr: Trong những năm trước, tác động thuế quan tập trung hơn trong các danh mục cụ thể, như điện tử hoặc các phân khúc quần áo nhất định.

segments.src: This year, the breadth of affected goods — from paper products to footwear — means fewer families have an easy substitution available.
segments.tr: Năm nay, phạm vi của các hàng hóa bị ảnh hưởng — từ các sản phẩm giấy đến giày dép — có nghĩa là ít gia đình hơn có một sự thay thế dễ dàng có sẵn.

segments.src: That breadth is part of why the story has resonated beyond typical economic reporting.
segments.tr: Phạm vi đó là một phần của lý do tại sao câu chuyện này đã vang vọng vượt ra ngoài báo cáo kinh tế điển hình.

segments.src: It isn't an abstract trade statistic; it shows up directly in a parent's total at the register.
segments.tr: Nó không phải là một thống kê giao dịch trừu tượng; nó xuất hiện trực tiếp trong tổng số của cha mẹ tại quầy thanh toán.

segments.src: ## What Families Are Doing Differently
segments.tr: ## Các gia đình làm gì khác đi

segments.src: Facing higher prices across nearly every category, many households are adjusting their shopping habits rather than simply absorbing the cost:
segments.tr: Đối mặt với giá cao hơn trên gần như mọi danh mục, nhiều hộ gia đình đang điều chỉnh thói quen mua sắm của họ thay vì chỉ đơn giản hấp thụ chi phí:

segments.src: - **Buying fewer items per category** and prioritizing what's absolutely required by the school's supply list.
segments.tr: - **Mua ít mặt hàng hơn trong mỗi danh mục** và ưu tiên những gì được yêu cầu tuyệt đối bởi danh sách cung cấp của trường.

segments.src: - **Shopping secondhand or swapping** clothing and supplies with other families.
segments.tr: - **Mua hàng đã qua sử dụng hoặc trao đổi** quần áo và nhu yếu phẩm với các gia đình khác.

segments.src: - **Spreading purchases out** across several weeks instead of one large shopping trip, to manage cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Phân tán mua sắm** trong vài tuần thay vì một chuyến mua sắm lớn, để quản lý dòng tiền mặt.

segments.src: - **Comparing store brands versus name brands** more aggressively than in past years.
segments.tr: - **So sánh nhãn hiệu cửa hàng với nhãn hiệu nổi tiếng** tích cực hơn trong những năm trước.

segments.src: - **Using layaway or installment options** at retailers that offer them, rather than defaulting straight to a credit card.
segments.tr: - **Sử dụng tùy chọn đặt cọc hoặc trả góp** tại các nhà bán lẻ cung cấp chúng, thay vì mặc định sử dụng thẻ tín dụng.

segments.src: Financial advisors generally caution that while short-term financing tools can help smooth a one-time expense, relying on revolving credit for a recurring annual cost like school shopping can create a cycle that's difficult to break, especially if next year's prices continue trending upward.
segments.tr: Các cố vấn tài chính thường cảnh báo rằng trong khi các công cụ tài chính ngắn hạn có thể giúp giảm bớt một khoản chi phí một lần, phụ thuộc vào tín dụng quay vòng cho một chi phí hàng năm định kỳ như mua sắm trường học có thể tạo ra một chu kỳ khó phá vỡ, đặc biệt nếu giá năm tới tiếp tục tăng.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Toàn cảnh lớn hơn

segments.src: Back-to-school spending is often treated as a bellwether for household financial health heading into the fall and holiday shopping season.
segments.tr: Chi tiêu chuẩn bị năm học mới thường được coi là một chỉ báo cho sức khỏe tài chính hộ gia đình hướng vào mùa thu và mùa mua sắm ngày lễ.

segments.src: If a growing share of families are financing routine purchases this early in the year, that trend is likely to draw closer attention from retailers, lenders, and policymakers alike in the months ahead.
segments.tr: Nếu một phần lớn các gia đình đang tài trợ cho các lần mua hàng thường xuyên sớm như vậy trong năm, xu hướng đó có khả năng thu hút sự chú ý gần hơn từ các nhà bán lẻ, người cho vay và những người hoạch định chính sách giống nhau trong những tháng tới.

segments.src: For now, though, the immediate reality for many parents is simpler and more pressing: get the list checked off, and figure out how to pay for it later.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, hiện tại, thực tế cấp bách cho nhiều bậc cha mẹ đơn giản hơn: hoàn thành danh sách mua sắm, và tìm ra cách trả tiền cho nó sau.
